_meta.description: Temporal query resolution test suite for ctx knowledge store

tests.rationale: Baseline: 'heute' is the most common temporal keyword. Must resolve to reference date.
English 'yesterday' resolves to day before reference date.
Typo: 'heite' → 'heute' (Levenshtein distance 1). Exercises fuzzy matching.
'morgen' resolves to next calendar day.

tests.query: what do I need to do tomorrow?
tests.rationale: English 'tomorrow' resolves identically to German 'morgen'.
'vorgestern' (day before yesterday) resolves to 2 days back.
'übermorgen' (day after tomorrow) resolves to 2 days forward.
'gestern' in a declarative statement (not question) still resolves.
Typo: 'morgrn' → 'morgen' (Levenshtein distance 1). Adjacent-key typo.
Typo: 'yesrerday' → 'yesterday' (Levenshtein distance 1: r→t substitution at pos 4). Tests English typo handling.

tests.query: am Montag will ich die Migration starten
tests.rationale: Future tense ('will ich') + 'Montag'. Next Monday is 2026-03-30. Requires tense detection to disambiguate.
Past tense ('war') + 'Montag'. Last Monday is 2026-03-23. Same weekday, opposite direction from W01.
Future intent ('steht an') + 'Freitag'. Next Friday is 2026-04-03. Note: Friday was 2 days ago, so future is next week.
Past tense ('war') + 'Freitag'. Last Friday is 2026-03-27 (2 days ago). Same weekday as W03, opposite direction.

tests.query: on Wednesday I deployed the fix
tests.rationale: English past tense + 'Wednesday'. Last Wednesday is 2026-03-25. Tests English weekday recognition.

tests.query: Dienstag treffe ich mich mit dem Team
tests.rationale: Future context ('treffe ich mich') + 'Dienstag'. Next Tuesday is 2026-03-31.
English past tense ('was cancelled') + 'Thursday'. Last Thursday is 2026-03-26.
'habe ich frei' implies a plan (future). Next Wednesday is 2026-04-01. Tricky: 'habe' is present tense but intent is future.
Past tense + 'Samstag'. Yesterday (Saturday 2026-03-28). Tests that same-name weekday resolves to yesterday, not 6 days forward.

tests.query: Donnerstag muss ich den Report abgeben
tests.rationale: Future obligation ('muss ich') + 'Donnerstag'. Next Thursday is 2026-04-02.
'letzte Woche' resolves to ISO week Mon-Sun: 2026-03-16 to 2026-03-22. Tests week boundary calculation.
'this week' = current ISO week. Today is Sunday, so Mon 2026-03-23 to Sun 2026-03-29. Edge case: today is the last day.

tests.query: nächste Woche habe ich viel vor
tests.rationale: 'nächste Woche' = next ISO week: Mon 2026-03-30 to Sun 2026-04-05. Crosses month boundary.

tests.query: vor 3 Tagen habe ich das gefixt
tests.rationale: 'vor N Tagen' pattern. 2026-03-29 minus 3 = 2026-03-26 (Thursday). Tests numeric relative day parsing.
'in N Tagen' pattern. 2026-03-29 plus 2 = 2026-03-31 (Tuesday). Tests numeric relative day parsing forward.

tests.query: was habe ich diesen Monat gemacht?
tests.rationale: 'diesen Monat' = current calendar month. March 1-31. Tests month boundary resolution.
'letzten Monat' = February 2026 (28 days, not a leap year). Tests previous month with correct day count.

tests.query: 3 days ago there was a production incident
tests.rationale: English 'N days ago' pattern. Same as R04 in English. Tests cross-language numeric relative parsing.

tests.query: in einer Woche muss das fertig sein
tests.rationale: 'in einer Woche' = 7 days from now = 2026-04-05. Tests 'einer' as numeric 1.
English 'last month' with possessive form. Same semantics as R07 but different syntax.
'seit Montag' = from last Monday to today (inclusive). Range 2026-03-23 to 2026-03-29. Tests 'seit' as range-start with implicit end=today.

tests.query: bis Freitag muss das fertig sein
tests.rationale: 'bis Freitag' = deadline. Range from today to next Friday 2026-04-03. Tests 'bis' as range-end with implicit start=today.

tests.query: Montag in einer Woche treffen wir uns
tests.rationale: 'Montag in einer Woche' = not next Monday (2026-03-30) but the one after (2026-04-06). Tests compound weekday + offset.

tests.query: übernächste Woche starten wir das Projekt
tests.rationale: 'übernächste Woche' = week after next. Mon 2026-04-06 to Sun 2026-04-12. Tests double-prefix compound.

tests.query: Anfang der Woche hatte ich das besprochen
tests.rationale: 'Anfang der Woche' = beginning of current week. Mon-Tue (2026-03-23 to 2026-03-24). Tests sub-week segment resolution.
'Ende nächster Woche' = end of next week. Thu-Sun (2026-04-03 to 2026-04-05). Tests sub-week segment on a different week.

tests.query: von Montag bis Mittwoch bin ich unterwegs
tests.rationale: 'von X bis Y' explicit range. Next Mon 2026-03-30 to next Wed 2026-04-01. Tests dual-weekday range with future default.

tests.query: letzten Dienstag bis Donnerstag war ich krank
tests.rationale: 'letzten' forces past. Tue 2026-03-24 to Thu 2026-03-26. Tests explicit past modifier on weekday range.
'seit vorgestern' = from 2 days ago to today. Range 2026-03-27 to 2026-03-29. Tests 'seit' + relative day.

tests.query: next Tuesday through Thursday I have meetings
tests.rationale: English compound range 'through'. Tue 2026-03-31 to Thu 2026-04-02. Tests English range syntax.
'neulich' = recently, vaguely. No precise date. Could boost results from last ~2 weeks. Tests graceful degradation for vague terms.
'bald' = soon, vaguely. No precise date. Could boost results in next ~2 weeks. Tests vague future handling.

tests.query: das letzte Mal als ich das gemacht habe
tests.rationale: 'letztes Mal' has no temporal anchor — it refers to a previous occurrence, not a date. Parser should flag as temporally indeterminate.

tests.query: am Wochenende will ich das fertig haben
tests.rationale: 'am Wochenende' + future tense. Today is Sunday (already weekend). 'will ich' indicates future, so next weekend: Sat 2026-04-04 to Sun 2026-04-05. Tricky: must not resolve to today.

tests.query: am Wochenende habe ich daran gearbeitet
tests.rationale: 'am Wochenende' + past tense. Today is Sunday. Past reference = this/current weekend (Sat 2026-03-28 to Sun 2026-03-29). Contrasts with A04.
Factual question about a concept. No temporal reference at all. Parser must return null/empty.
Technical how-does-it-work question. No temporal reference. Parser must return null/empty.

tests.query: show me all blocks with category infrastructure
tests.rationale: Pure listing/filter query. No temporal reference. Parser must return null/empty.
'wurden' is past tense but the query asks about historical facts, not a specific time period. Parser should not infer temporal bounds from generic past tense.

tests.query: was ist der Unterschied zwischen shared und private scope?
tests.rationale: Conceptual comparison question. No temporal reference. Parser must return null/empty.

tests.query: heute und morgen habe ich frei
tests.rationale: Two temporal keywords in one query. Both must resolve: heute=2026-03-29, morgen=2026-03-30. Tests multi-keyword extraction.

tests.query: von gestern bis übermorgen läuft der Test
tests.rationale: 'von gestern bis übermorgen' = explicit range using two relative keywords. 2026-03-28 to 2026-03-31. Tests range from relative-to-relative.

tests.query: todya I need to fix the temporal parser
tests.rationale: Typo: 'todya' → 'today' (Levenshtein distance 2, within tolerance for 5-char word). Tests English typo tolerance at boundary.

tests.query: Mittwoch Morgen findet das Meeting statt
tests.rationale: 'Morgen' as time-of-day (morning) must NOT be confused with 'morgen' (tomorrow). Case-insensitive parser must use context ('Mittwoch Morgen' = Wednesday morning). Tests false-positive avoidance.
Weekday embedded in compound noun with hyphens. Parser must extract 'Montag' from 'Montag-Morgen-Call'. Tests tokenization of hyphenated compounds.
Explicit ISO date in query text. Parser should recognize and extract ISO date literals directly.
Two distinct past-relative keywords joined with 'und'. Both must resolve independently. Tests multi-keyword past extraction.
Empty query string. Parser must handle gracefully and return null/empty without panic.
Repeated keyword. Must deduplicate — only one date in result, not three. Tests idempotent deduplication.

tests.query: vor 0 Tagen gab es ein Problem
tests.rationale: 'vor 0 Tagen' is technically today. Edge case in numeric parsing: zero offset must work and equal today.
